items.label: nginx vhost pocketful.getn.space
items.details: TLS terminator. Proxies ONLY to the wallet process; the API port is not in the vhost. The existing [::]:443 block already owns ipv6only=on — this block inherits and must omit it.

items.label: Browser (a view, never a key holder)
items.details: Generates no idempotency key, stores none, sends none. No hidden field, cookie or URL param carries one.

items.label: Wallet web server (app/web.py)
items.details: stdlib http.server, loopback-fronted. GET / , POST /send -> 303 See Other (PRG), POST /retry, GET /health. Mints and persists the key in Python. Rendering never writes.

items.label: Wallet UI: balance + activity feed
items.details: Reads server truth only. Never sums a local list to compute a balance.

items.label: Send flow: key generation + persistence
items.details: One key per user press, persisted before the first attempt, reused on every retry including after restart.

items.label: API client (integer minor units only)
items.details: No parseFloat, no toFixed on a sent amount. Display formatting happens at the edge.

items.label: Key store (app/keystore.py)
items.details: Holds PENDING keys. Durability-critical: same ext4 root volume as the DB, never /tmp or network storage. A lost store is a fresh key on retry = double-spend.

items.label: HTTP routes
items.details: POST /accounts, GET /accounts/{id}/balance, POST /transfers, GET /accounts/{id}/activity

items.label: Request validation
items.details: Reject, do not coerce. Non-integer / bool / zero / negative / out-of-range amounts are 400/422.

items.label: Idempotency-Key header handling
items.details: Key is read from the header; replay returns the stored response; same key + different body is 409.

items.label: Ledger operations
items.details: open_account, get_balance, transfer, split — the only writers of money.

items.label: Double-entry writer
items.details: Every mutation writes entries summing to zero. No balance is mutated without a paired entry.

items.label: Idempotency store
items.details: Key + fingerprint + result written in the same transaction that applies the transfer.

items.label: Deterministic split
items.details: Parts sum exactly to the total; remainder distributed by a documented policy, never truncated away.

items.label: accounts
items.details: account_id, owner_id, currency, allow_overdraft, version, created_at

items.label: ledger_entries
items.details: Signed INTEGER amount_minor. Balances are a derived view; no cached balance column in v1.

items.label: idempotency_keys
items.details: key PRIMARY KEY, request_fingerprint, transfer_id, response_json — the uniqueness that makes replay safe.

items.label: I1–I6 assertions
items.details: Reusable functions every scenario calls.

items.label: Concurrency harness
items.details: Parallel transfer storm, 100x same-key retry storm, failure atomicity, fuzz.

items.label: Gate command
items.details: One command runs tests + build + lint; its quoted output is the only accepted proof of done.
